notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41184429/1ad688af93e88bdda4f45124a3b674bc16049c09.png[/img]

Several changes have been made right before the official release:

1. New CG added. 
2. Translation updated. The English and Japanese translation has been improved.
3. "Adult Mode" configuration added. You can now turn off adult mode and go live streaming.

Hope you like it!
